body: Strong leading signal, pero huwag nating gawing ‘2018-level boom’ ang phrase na fastest growth rate since 2018. PMI is directional, not volume. Ang next evidence I want is triangulation: official industrial production, machinery orders, exports, then corporate capex. If those confirm while backlogs and hiring stay elevated, saka mas credible na broad cycle ito. If not, possible na diffusion breadth lang ang lumakas habang actual volume gains remain modest or concentrated sa semiconductor/AI chain.

claims.text: Official production, machinery-order, export and capex data are needed to distinguish a durable broad manufacturing upswing from a survey-led or sector-concentrated improvement.
claims.basis: Inference from the limitations of PMI diffusion data already established in the article
